meta.title: Meeks | Encrypted chat and video calls — just share a URL
meta.description: Meeks is an end-to-end encrypted (E2EE) chat you start by sharing a URL. No sign-up. Messages are never stored on the server and travel peer-to-peer. Share files and photos, make video calls, and see who has read your messages.
meta.ogDescription: No sign-up. End-to-end encrypted and peer-to-peer — messages never stay on the server. File sharing and video calls included.
meta.ogImageAlt: Meeks - Encrypted chat, just share a URL
meta.ldDescription: End-to-end encrypted chat you start by sharing a URL. Peer-to-peer messaging, file sharing and video calls.
home.tagline: Just share a URL for end-to-end encrypted chat, file sharing and video calls.
home.createHint: Creates a random URL. People you share it with request to join and enter once a member approves them.
home.customHint: Letters, numbers, "-" and "_" only. If a room with this name exists you request to join it; otherwise a new room is created.
home.reservedName: This name cannot be used as a room name
features.title: Why Meeks
features.e2ee.title: End-to-end encrypted
features.e2ee.body: Messages, files and calls are encrypted on your device. Not even the server operator can read them.
features.noStore.title: Nothing stays on the server
features.noStore.body: Messages are not stored on the server; participants exchange them directly, peer-to-peer. History is kept on each device and synced between participants.
features.url.title: Just send a URL
features.url.body: No account and no app to install. Share a URL, approve who joins, and you are ready.
features.files.title: Share files and photos
features.files.body: Send images, videos and documents up to 100 MB, encrypted all the way.
features.video.title: Video calls
features.video.body: Video calls right in your browser, with encrypted video and audio.
features.read.title: Read receipts
features.read.body: See who has read each message. You can even chat with people while their request to join is pending.
room.safetyHint: If everyone sees the same code, you all use the same encryption key.
room.clearConfirm: Delete this room's history stored on this device?
room.joinCodeNote: (the person approving you sees the same code)
